# Assist media lifecycle host tests

The twelve C++ cases compile the maintained `speaker_source` and `audio_http`
providers with the official ESPHome 2026.10.0 host-test runner. AudioReader,
DecoderSource0.4.0, the FLAC decoder and pthread create/join are real. HTTP
transport, the speaker sink and the player's FreeRTOS queue interface are host
fixtures. There is no ESP SDK or HTTP server in this test.

`scripts/test_assist_media_host.py` requires explicit dependency directories and
a build directory. Missing dependencies, a missing test, a skipped case or a
failed sanitizer run fail the job. The regular CI workflow includes this job;
it is not an optional diagnostic lane.

Dependencies are pinned in CI:

- ESPHome 2026.10.0: `704551a6c93c29a311802f7ee97d67a9e9bce718`.
- micro-decoder 0.4.0: `4d06df93a1ee69788dfc7d8676cbd66371b3eae9`.
- micro-flac 0.3.0: `f9c27d4d0166021db977d7fc37d205b21d81e9f2`.

For local execution, check out those revisions in the directories below and
install `requirements-firmware-test.txt`. Set `BUILD_ROOT` to an existing
persistent disk directory. Then run:

```sh
python scripts/test_assist_media_host.py --esphome-source .test-deps/esphome \
  --micro-decoder .test-deps/micro-decoder --micro-flac .test-deps/micro-flac \
  --build-parent "$BUILD_ROOT/assist-media" --junit test-results/assist-media.xml
python -m pytest -q tests/test_voice_assistant_idle_runtime.py
```

The six Python-collected VA cases execute the exact production transition
methods and IDLE branch in a small host class. They are not a complete VA
integration test. All eighteen cases are software regressions, not physical
TTS, microphone, display, RAM-headroom or acoustic qualification.

The 60 KiB audio fixture is synthetic. `reference.pcm` is 16000 little-endian
signed 16-bit mono samples, generated by `(i * 73) % 30000 - 15000`. `fixture.flac`
encodes that exact PCM at 16000 Hz. No microphone or third-party recording is
included. The independent PCM reference checks decoded byte order and complete
output, including the queued and callback-started second playback.

The FreeRTOS queue fixture preserves bounded FIFO behavior and records commands;
it does not emulate task scheduling. The pthread wrappers always delegate to
the real functions and record successful calls, so explicit cleanup cannot
hide a missing natural join from the captured assertions.
